map.N-Back 是工作记忆研究的经典范式：每个刺激出现时，判断它与「前 N 个」刺: N-Back is a classic working-memory paradigm: when each stimulus appears, judge whether it matches the 'N-th previous' stimulus on the corresponding channel. Supports single channel (position) and dual channel (position+letter/digit/color); N can be fixed or adaptive; gives real-time position hit rate, voice hit rate and the signal-detection metric d', and draws a training curve by day.
map.📖 查看「N-Back 工作记忆训练使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for N-Back Working-Memory Training
map.命中率 HR = 命中数 / 信号试次数，虚报率 FA = 虚报数 / 噪声试次: Hit rate HR = hits / signal trials, false-alarm rate FA = false alarms / noise trials. Log-linear correction (HR'=(H+0.5)/(S+1), FA'=(F+0.5)/(N+1)) avoids 0/1 extremes; z-scores come from Acklam's inverse-normal CDF approximation, d' = z(HR') - z(FA'). Under dual channel, position and letter compute d' independently. Adaptive rule: 4 consecutive all-correct raises N+1 (cap 9), 3 consecutive errors lowers N-1 (floor 1).

map.工作记忆训练：从 2-back 起步，命中率稳定后提升到 3-back，渐进增加: Working-memory training: start from 2-back, raise to 3-back once hit rate is stable, gradually increasing memory load.
map.敏感度（d′）测算：结合命中率与虚报率计算信号检测论指标，评估辨别力而非单纯正确: Sensitivity (d') estimation: combine hit rate and false-alarm rate to compute the signal-detection metric, assessing discriminability rather than mere accuracy.
map.研究/自我追踪：记录不同 N 下的命中率、虚报率与反应时，观察训练前后的工作记忆: Research/self-tracking: record hit rate, false-alarm rate and reaction time at different N, observing working-memory capacity change before/after training.

map.N 表示「往前数第几个」：2-back 即判断当前刺激是否与它前面第 2 个相同: N means 'count back how many': 2-back judges whether the current stimulus matches the one 2 before it; larger N means higher memory load.
map.命中率高低就能说明记忆好坏？: Does hit-rate level alone show memory quality?
map.不完全。高命中常伴随高虚报，需结合虚报率算 d′（敏感度）才能区分「真记得」与「: Not fully. High hits often accompany high false alarms; you need d' (sensitivity) with the false-alarm rate to distinguish 'truly remembered' from 'guessed right'.
map.能替代记忆力临床诊断？: Can it replace clinical memory diagnosis?
map.不能。这是训练与自评工具，结果受状态、疲劳、练习效应影响，认知评估请交由专业机构: No. This is a training and self-rating tool; results are affected by state, fatigue and practice effect; leave cognitive assessment to professional institutions.
